changelog: Cuffing, sit-on-ground, escort and vehicle seating reworked: no more teleporting, smoother animations, no stuck poses.
Deployment menu now lets you keep moving; Alt toggles the cursor.
14 predefined scenes for grade 6+ officers: roadblocks, checkpoints, accident and crime scenes, tactical staging.
Place a whole scene with one raycast click, wheel to rotate, with a ghost preview of every piece.
New scenes-per-officer setting; scenes editable live in /conf_acn_policejobV2.
Progressive Front & Rear Handcuffs with automatic relative position detection and paired animations.
